title: Difficult to hold for a woman
text: Difficult to hold for a woman. These glasses are much too large for a woman’s hand to hold safely and comfortably.  They should be labeled for men only.  I have large hands for a woman but I just can’t feel safe holding these glasses.  Why doesn’t the company make smaller ones for women and label them?

product_metadata.title: Boston Warehouse Insulated Plastic Tumblers, 24-Ounce, Set of 4, Clear Collection
features: MULTI PURPOSE: No matter the beverage, the Boston Warehouse Insulated Tumblers work for all of your hot or cold beverage choices including smoothies, protein drinks, hot coffee or tea, iced coffees and teas, fresh juices, waters, sodas, milk shakes (or frappes) and much more!

VERSATILE: No matter the location, these tumblers are great for indoor and outdoor use without worrying about the potential for dangerous glass breakage. Perfect for year-round use: at home or in the office, at picnics or BBQs, pool-side or by the firepit. Sized to fit most standard car cup holders, you can even take these tumblers on-the-go.

SAFE AND SMART CONSTRUCTION: Double-wall insulated construction prevents condensation and sweating which keeps your hands and surfaces dry. Made from food-safe BPA-free, break-resistant, plastic the tumblers are safer than glass tumblers. Wide opening makes for easy filling and easy cleaning.

ON TREND AND ON BUDGET: No matter your style, the tumblers are on trend and budget friendly. Assorted color offerings (clear, sunset and marine) will match most indoor and outdoor design schemes. Tumblers come packaged and priced in a convenient set of 4.
CARE TIPS: Hand wash only and do not use to reheat beverages in the microwave
description: Whether you like your drinks straight up, on the rocks, shaken or stirred, hot or cold, the Boston Warehouse Insulated Tumbler will keep your beverages at the perfect temperature and your tabletops perfectly dry. Designed with double-wall insulation, each tumbler prevents condensation and sweating – which means no more “slippery cup” spills, no more ruined surfaces from water rings, and no need to search for a coaster. Suitable for all your beverage drinking needs - use them for smoothies, protein drinks, hot coffee or tea, iced coffees and teas, fresh juices, waters, sodas, milk shakes or frappes and much more The large opening allows for easy filling and makes cleaning a breeze. Unlike glass tumblers, the Boston Warehouse Insulated tumblers are constructed of break-resistant plastic, making them safe for both indoor and outdoor use without worrying about the potential for dangerous glass breakage. Perfect for year-round use: at home or in the office, at picnics or BBQs, pool-side or by the firepit. Sized to fit most standard car cup holders, you can even take these tumblers on-the-go. Available as a set of 4, these tumblers combine value and versatility with size 16 ounce or 24 ounce, measured to top of cup and color choice clear, sunset, or marine.
